about.title: Islamic Center For Muslims To Achieve Spiritual Goals
about.motto: Our Promise To Uphold The Trust Placed.
about.body: e‑Tasmi began in neighbourhood halaqah circles that tracked recitation on paper timetables and whispered checkpoints. We built an integrated, transparent, audited workflow so Malaysian madrasahs, families, and state panels share one view—Surah by Surah, Juz by Juz, milestone by milestone—without losing the sanctity of guided Tasmi.
about.imageAlt: Guided online Qur'an recitation session with learner and instructor

pricing.title: Pay · verify ·
pricing.lead: Fees stay with your programme—e‑Tasmi is where you register, attach proof of payment when asked, then join sessions once an admin confirms you.
pricing.flowTitle: QR or link, receipt, verification—then enrol.
pricing.flowDesc: Your madrasah, school, or organiser publishes how to pay. Follow their steps outside e‑Tasmi when needed, keep your slip or screenshot, then complete the confirmations inside your new account.

step1.title: Start from their QR
step1.desc: Scan or open the enrolment QR or personalised link so you land in the correct cohort intake without retyping programme codes.

step2.title: Attach your receipt
step2.desc: Pay through the channels your organisers specify, then upload a clear receipt snapshot from the dashboard wherever proof is requested.

step3.title: Verification unlocks enrolment
step3.desc: After organisers review payment, you enrol in Tasmi rounds, submit recitations inside each window, and read instructor remarks in context.

pricing.benefit3: Receipt uploads tied to your intake record
pricing.benefit4: Recitation uploads, instructor notes, feedback timelines
pricing.footnote: Questions about dues or subsidies go to your organiser first—admin tools inside e‑Tasmi decide when you can join live sessions.
